name: the Legend of the Deep - Episode II
source:
Right after a silence of the Telomere Kingdom, something unusual starts growing larger in the Tilene Kingdom that shares a border with Telomere. 

For the crisis, the leader of the Violet Order Lesfina and her subordinate Elicia are summoned to the Kingdom. On their way to the Kingdom, however, they happen to step foot in the forbidden place called the forest of darkness...

Concurrently, at the center of the forest is an apprentice witch named Primm initiating a ritual of summoning a spirit. When the ritual is done, she is faced by a group of monsters that she has never seen.

The three girls' hardship is about to begin now.

[Edited from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ233318.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
端粒王国沉寂之后，与端粒接壤的提林王国中，某种不寻常的东西开始变得更大。

为了应对危机，紫罗兰教团的首领莱斯菲娜和她的部下艾丽西亚被召唤到王国。然而，在前往王国的途中，他们却恰巧踏入了名为黑暗森林的禁地……

与此同时，在森林的中心，一位名叫普里姆的女巫学徒正在发起召唤灵魂的仪式。当仪式完成后，她面对的是一群她从未见过的怪物。

三个女孩的磨难现在就要开始了。
